findings.description: The plan reuses the 008 Domain trait for `microphones list`, whose data needs a device catalog (offline headless enumeration) and live effective input. In the merged 008 (HEAD 0fb75ae) `Domain::plan(request, &AppSettings)` is pure, "no I/O and no live effect", and `LiveOnly(Value)` is still computed from settings; the instance-side backend answers from the published settings snapshot. Implementing the list therefore requires extending the 008 framework (a runtime context or read port), which the 008 plan said later owners would not need to change.
findings.suggestion: State the framework extension explicitly (for example a domain read context with catalog and live-state ports, absent offline) and its tests, instead of "reuse".

findings.description: Plan-era 008 names do not match the merged 008: there is no `LiveSettingsEffects` (effects.rs behind LiveSettings); UI writes must go through `settings_service::tauri_adapter` (`edit` for a typed list edit); a list change is a `ChangeKind::Apply` edit; descriptor data lives in descriptor_data.rs where `selected_microphone` is currently generic-settable and owned by the "microphones" domain.

findings.description: The deadline allocation can give a configured attempt less than the 2 s the spec states ("Each open attempt times out after 2 seconds"): the default slot is reserved and the remaining normal budget is divided across candidates. This resolves a real tension between the 2 s and 6 s bounds, but a device that opens in 1.5 s may fail with four candidates.
findings.suggestion: Record the allocation rule as an accepted interpretation (spec-refine) or keep 2 s per attempt and let the 6 s deadline cut the list.
